channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Oct 16
item.description:
76 development commits

Combat

  • Fixed delay where attached grenades were invisible until a viewmodel event, ensuring they appear correctly when spawned.

Building & Structures

  • Added an invisible, invulnerable building tier with collision that can host items, useful for blocking areas or creating floating displays.
  • Improved Warhead Garage Door colliders for finer, more precise movement and updated its prefab LODs and scripts.

Server & Settings

  • Resolved an issue where joining clients reset server convars, including gamemode settings, when using C+S.

Interactions

  • Adjusted interaction order so leading interaction remains default before petting livestock.

NPC & AI

  • Fixed animals not attacking players standing next to vehicles.

Upkeep & Decay

  • Prevented bases from decaying despite TC upkeep on high-entity-count servers by adjusting decay tick budgeting.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Scarecrows now work reliably during the Halloween 2026 event.
  • Turn transitions are now smooth; player actions no longer get dropped or delayed.
  • Tattoo painting no longer causes unintended fading of new ink.
  • Dungeon bugs fixed, improving stability and preventing players from getting stuck.
  • Crab and jellyfish gathering jobs now complete successfully, fixing previous errors that prevented resource collection.

item.title: Rust Development Updates — Oct 15
item.description:
116 development commits

World & Exploration

  • Lighthouse now requires repair; fixing restores its light and opens access to the deep sea area.

Clans & Game Modes

  • Clan features have been disabled in Softcore and the clan table is now a restricted item in both Softcore and Hardcore, fixing tech‑tree displays.

Structures & Building

  • Uploaded signs (uploadsign) no longer get cleared unexpectedly due to an internal keying issue.
  • Nailgun muzzle point fixed, allowing it to be placed in turrets without errors.

Combat

  • Grenade throws now behave correctly: side‑swing when standing still is fixed and release timing is synchronized across animations.

User Interface & Store

  • Pause menu now shows the actual server name and boat privilege UI no longer displays edit‑mode privileges you lack.
  • Store pages now reference the correct assets, fixing previously incorrect item displays.

Performance & Audio

  • Snapshot send budget implemented to reduce client stutter when loading large bases; server now caps snapshots per tick.
  • Biofuel generator stirring sound no longer cuts off prematurely and movement sound triggers work correctly after collider fixes.
